asks.name: conventions-upfront
asks.message: Before I start: are there conventions here for how a name under this domain is shaped, and for how long a caller may keep an answer?
asks.note: the question every agent opens with, asked before anything has happened: it cites nothing and reaches nobody

asks.name: origin-in-the-way
asks.message: The name I was told to publish already answers 198.51.100.25, and an entry marked pre-cutover-origin sits beside it. Does that answer have to stay reachable once the routed set takes the name?

asks.name: how-long-may-an-answer-be-kept
asks.message: Reading the zone I find an entry stating max-cache-30s. Does that bind how long the answers I publish may be kept?

asks.name: which-address-does-the-region-take
asks.message: There is an entry at _edges.example53.com putting that region's edge on 192.0.2.140. Is that where the answer should point instead of the address I was handed?

asks.name: must-an-answer-be-watched
asks.message: An entry in the zone says answers-are-watched. Do the answers I publish have to hang off something probing the address they give?

asks.name: effect-described-not-named
asks.message: An address I never published is answering where I was asked to publish, and what I wrote came back with a shorter lifetime than I gave it. Is that meant to be?
asks.note: describes the effects in words without citing anything that was read, so it routes to nobody

asks.name: generic
asks.message: Any conventions I should follow here?
